headline: TCC Concept issues postal ballot notice for shareholder voting
hook: Remote voting opens for shareholder approvals
summary: TCC Concept Limited has issued a Postal Ballot Notice dated October 9, 2026, to seek member approval via remote e-voting. The explanatory statement accompanying the notice details the resolutions put forth for voting. Shareholders will cast their votes electronically within the specified timeline. Routine corporate governance proceedings of this nature have minimal impact on broader market indices.
why_it_matters: Standard governance update with no direct impact on stock price

headline: TCC Concept notifies exchange regarding upcoming shareholders meeting
summary: TCC Concept Limited has formally informed the stock exchange about an upcoming meeting of its shareholders. The filing provides the procedural update without detailing specific agenda items or resolutions to be voted upon. Such meetings are routine corporate governance requirements for listed entities. Indian retail investors holding the stock should verify the meeting agenda for any corporate actions.
whats_next: Shareholders meeting date and agenda details
why_it_matters: Routine meeting notice with no immediate valuation impact.
